title: Coffee in Nicosia
setting: A café near the Selimiye Mosque in Lefkoşa (Nicosia). You order a Turkish coffee.
settingTr: Lefkoşa'da, Selimiye Camii'nin yanında bir kafe.

lines.speaker: Garson
lines.en: Hello, welcome!

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: Hello! A Turkish coffee, please.

lines.speaker: Garson
lines.tr: Nasıl olsun? Şekerli mi, sade mi?
lines.en: How would you like it? With sugar or plain?

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: Medium-sweet, please.

lines.speaker: Garson
lines.en: Would you like anything else?

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.tr: Bir de su, lütfen. Hesap ne kadar?
lines.en: And a water, please. How much is the bill?

lines.speaker: Garson
lines.en: One hundred lira in total.

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: Here you are. Thank you!

lines.speaker: Garson
lines.en: You're welcome, enjoy!

writing.prompt: You're at a café. Write 3–5 sentences you would say to the waiter: greet them, order two things and ask for the bill.
writing.promptTr: Kafedesin. Garsona ne söylersin? 3–5 cümle yaz.

title: The bus to Kyrenia
setting: At the main bus station in Lefkoşa. You want to catch a bus to Girne (Kyrenia).

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: Excuse me, where does the Kyrenia bus leave from?

lines.speaker: Görevli
lines.en: From over there, platform three.

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: What time does it leave?

lines.speaker: Görevli
lines.tr: Her yarım saatte bir. Sonraki otobüs on dakika sonra.
lines.en: Every half hour. The next bus is in ten minutes.

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: How much is the ticket?

lines.speaker: Görevli
lines.en: Sixty lira. You can pay the driver.

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: How long does it take to Kyrenia?

lines.speaker: Görevli
lines.en: It takes about half an hour.

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: Thanks a lot!

lines.speaker: Görevli
lines.en: You're welcome, have a good trip!

glossary.meaning: the bus (in 'Girne otobüsü' = the Kyrenia bus)
journeys (iyi yolculuklar = have a good trip)

phrases.en: Where does the bus leave from?

writing.prompt: You need to get to Gazimağusa (Famagusta). Write 3–5 questions you would ask at the bus station.
writing.promptTr: Gazimağusa'ya gitmek istiyorsun. Otogarda ne sorarsın?

title: At the market
setting: The Wednesday market in Lefkoşa. You buy vegetables and halloumi.

lines.speaker: Satıcı
lines.en: Come on in, there are fresh tomatoes!

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: How much is a kilo of tomatoes?

lines.speaker: Satıcı
lines.en: Forty lira a kilo.

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.tr: İki kilo domates, lütfen. Bu salatalıklar taze mi?
lines.en: Two kilos of tomatoes, please. Are these cucumbers fresh?

lines.speaker: Satıcı
lines.tr: Tabii, bu sabah geldi. Kaç tane istiyorsunuz?
lines.en: Of course, they came this morning. How many would you like?

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.tr: Üç tane. Bir de yarım kilo hellim alabilir miyim?
lines.en: Three. Can I also have half a kilo of halloumi?

lines.speaker: Satıcı
lines.tr: Tabii. Hepsi iki yüz elli lira.
lines.en: Sure. That's two hundred and fifty lira altogether.

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: Here you are. Take it easy!

lines.speaker: Satıcı
lines.en: Thank you, come again!

writing.prompt: Write a short shopping list in Turkish (4–5 items with amounts), then one sentence asking the price.
writing.promptTr: Türkçe bir alışveriş listesi yaz ve fiyat sor.

title: A new colleague at the university
setting: In the corridor of your faculty. A colleague, Ayşe, introduces herself.

lines.speaker: Ayşe
lines.en: Hi, are you new?

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: Yes, I started this semester.

lines.speaker: Ayşe
lines.tr: Memnun oldum! Ben Ayşe. Hangi bölümdesin?
lines.en: Nice to meet you! I'm Ayşe. Which department are you in?

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: I'm in the education department. I'm doing a PhD.

lines.speaker: Ayşe
lines.en: Great! Where are you from?

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.tr: İngiltereliyim ama iki yıldır Kıbrıs'ta yaşıyorum.
lines.en: I'm from England but I've been living in Cyprus for two years.

lines.speaker: Ayşe
lines.en: Your Turkish is very good!

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: Thanks, but I'm still learning.

lines.speaker: Ayşe
lines.en: Shall we meet at the café at lunchtime?

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: Sure, see you!

glossary.meaning: I am in the department of …

phrases.en: I've been living in Cyprus for two years.
Shall we meet at the café?

writing.prompt: Introduce yourself: name, country, job, where you live. Write 3–5 sentences.
writing.promptTr: Kendini tanıt: adın, ülken, işin, nerede yaşadığın.

title: At the pharmacy
setting: A pharmacy in Girne. You have a headache.

lines.speaker: Eczacı
lines.en: Hello, how can I help?

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.tr: Merhaba. Başım çok ağrıyor. Bir ilaç alabilir miyim?
lines.en: Hello. I have a bad headache. Can I get some medicine?

lines.speaker: Eczacı
lines.en: Of course. Do you have a fever?

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.tr: Hayır, ateşim yok ama biraz yorgunum.
lines.en: No, I don't have a fever but I'm a bit tired.

lines.speaker: Eczacı
lines.tr: Bu ilacı günde iki kere alın. Yemekten sonra.
lines.en: Take this medicine twice a day. After meals.

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: Okay. How much is it?

lines.speaker: Eczacı
lines.en: Eighty-five lira.

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: Can I pay by card?

lines.speaker: Eczacı
lines.en: Sure. Get well soon!

writing.prompt: You feel ill. Write 3–5 sentences to a pharmacist describing how you feel and asking for help.

title: Breakfast from the bakery
setting: A neighbourhood bakery early in the morning.

lines.speaker: Fırıncı
lines.en: Good morning! What would you like?

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.tr: Günaydın! İki tane pilavuna ve bir ekmek, lütfen.
lines.en: Good morning! Two pilavunas and a loaf of bread, please.

lines.speaker: Fırıncı
lines.en: The pilavunas are hot, they've just come out of the oven.

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: Great! Are there halloumi pastries?

lines.speaker: Fırıncı
lines.en: Unfortunately they're finished. There are olive ones.

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.tr: Tamam, bir tane zeytinli de alayım.
lines.en: Okay, I'll take an olive one too.

lines.speaker: Fırıncı
lines.en: That's ninety lira altogether.

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: Here you are. Have a nice day!

lines.speaker: Fırıncı
lines.en: Have a nice day too!

writing.prompt: Describe your ideal breakfast in 3–5 Turkish sentences.

title: Taxi to Ercan Airport
setting: You take a taxi from Lefkoşa to Ercan Airport.

lines.speaker: Şoför
lines.en: Hello, where are we going?

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: To Ercan Airport, please.

lines.speaker: Şoför
lines.en: Okay. What time is your flight?

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: At twelve. Will we make it?

lines.speaker: Şoför
lines.tr: Merak etmeyin, trafik yok. Kırk dakikada varırız.
lines.en: Don't worry, there's no traffic. We'll arrive in forty minutes.

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.tr: Klimayı biraz açabilir misiniz? Çok sıcak.
lines.en: Could you turn on the air conditioning a bit? It's very hot.

lines.speaker: Şoför
lines.en: Of course, I'm turning it on right away.

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: How much will it cost?

lines.speaker: Şoför
lines.en: One thousand two hundred lira.

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: Okay, thank you.

phrases.en: Could you turn on the air conditioning?

writing.prompt: You're in a taxi. Write 3–5 sentences: tell the driver where to go, ask how long it takes and how much it costs.
writing.promptTr: Taksidesin. Şoföre nereye gittiğini söyle ve soru sor.

title: Chatting with a neighbour
setting: On the stairs of your apartment building on a hot summer morning.
settingTr: Sıcak bir yaz sabahı, apartmanın merdivenlerinde.

lines.speaker: Komşu
lines.en: Good morning! How are you?

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: Good morning! I'm fine, thanks. How are you?

lines.speaker: Komşu
lines.tr: Ben de iyiyim. Bugün hava çok sıcak, değil mi?
lines.en: I'm fine too. It's very hot today, isn't it?

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: Yes, very hot. I'm going to the sea.

lines.speaker: Komşu
lines.en: How nice! Which beach are you going to?

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: I'm going to Alagadi. I want to see the turtles.

lines.speaker: Komşu
lines.tr: Çok güzel bir yer. Şapkanızı unutmayın!
lines.en: It's a lovely place. Don't forget your hat!

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: I won't. Have a nice day!

lines.speaker: Komşu
lines.en: Have fun!

writing.prompt: Write 3–5 sentences of small talk about today's weather and your plans for today.
writing.promptTr: Bugünkü hava ve planların hakkında 3–5 cümle yaz.

title: Dinner at Kyrenia harbour
setting: A fish restaurant at Kyrenia's old harbour.
settingTr: Girne'nin eski limanında bir balık lokantası.

lines.speaker: Garson
lines.en: Welcome! How many of you are there?

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.tr: İki kişiyiz. Deniz manzaralı bir masa var mı?
lines.en: We're two. Is there a table with a sea view?

lines.speaker: Garson
lines.en: Yes, here you go. Here's the menu.

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.tr: Teşekkürler. Bugün taze balık var mı?
lines.en: Thanks. Is there fresh fish today?

lines.speaker: Garson
lines.tr: Var. Levrek ve çipura çok taze.
lines.en: Yes. The sea bass and sea bream are very fresh.

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.tr: Bir ızgara levrek ve bir meze tabağı alalım.
lines.en: Let's have a grilled sea bass and a meze platter.

lines.speaker: Garson
lines.en: What would you like to drink?

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.tr: Bir şişe su ve iki ayran, lütfen.
lines.en: A bottle of water and two ayrans, please.

lines.speaker: Garson
lines.en: I'll bring them right away.

phrases.tr: Deniz manzaralı bir masa var mı?
phrases.en: Is there a table with a sea view?
What would you like to drink?

writing.prompt: Write 3–5 sentences ordering a meal for two people at a restaurant, including drinks.
writing.promptTr: Bir lokantada iki kişilik yemek siparişi ver.

title: Looking for a flat
setting: An estate agent shows you a flat in Gazimağusa (Famagusta).
settingTr: Gazimağusa'da bir emlakçı sana bir daire gösteriyor.

lines.speaker: Emlakçı
lines.en: Hello, what kind of home are you looking for?

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.tr: İki odalı bir daire arıyorum. Üniversiteye yakın olsun.
lines.en: I'm looking for a two-room flat. Close to the university, please.

lines.speaker: Emlakçı
lines.tr: Bu dairenin iki yatak odası ve büyük bir balkonu var.
lines.en: This flat has two bedrooms and a big balcony.

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: How much is the rent?

lines.speaker: Emlakçı
lines.en: Four hundred pounds a month.

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: Are bills included?

lines.speaker: Emlakçı
lines.tr: Hayır, faturalar dahil değil. Ama ev eşyalı.
lines.en: No, bills aren't included. But it's furnished.

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: Is there air conditioning?

lines.speaker: Emlakçı
lines.en: Yes, there's air conditioning in every room.

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: Nice. Can I look again tomorrow?

phrases.en: What kind of home are you looking for?

writing.prompt: Describe your home in 3–5 sentences: how many rooms, what it has, what you like about it.
writing.promptTr: Evini anlat: kaç oda, neler var, neyi seviyorsun?

title: At the doctor's
setting: A clinic in Lefkoşa. You have a sore throat and a cough.
settingTr: Lefkoşa'da bir klinik. Boğazın ağrıyor ve öksürüyorsun.

lines.speaker: Doktor
lines.en: Come in, sit down. What's the problem?

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.tr: Üç gündür boğazım ağrıyor ve öksürüyorum.
lines.en: My throat has been hurting for three days and I'm coughing.

lines.speaker: Doktor
lines.en: Do you have a fever?

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: I had a slight fever last night.

lines.speaker: Doktor
lines.en: Open your mouth, please. Your throat is red.

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: Is it something serious?

lines.speaker: Doktor
lines.tr: Hayır, ciddi değil. Size bir şurup yazıyorum.
lines.en: No, it's not serious. I'm prescribing you a syrup.

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: When will I get better?

lines.speaker: Doktor
lines.tr: Bol su için ve dinlenin. Bir haftada iyileşirsiniz.
lines.en: Drink plenty of water and rest. You'll get better in a week.

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: Thank you, doctor.

phrases.en: Drink plenty of water and rest.

writing.prompt: Write 3–5 sentences to a doctor: what hurts, since when, and one question.
writing.promptTr: Doktora nereni ağrıdığını ve ne zamandan beri olduğunu anlat.

title: At the university library
setting: The university library. You're looking for a book for your thesis.
settingTr: Üniversite kütüphanesi. Tezin için bir kitap arıyorsun.

lines.speaker: Görevli
lines.en: Hello, can I help you?

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.tr: Merhaba. Bu kitabı arıyorum ama rafta bulamıyorum.
lines.en: Hello. I'm looking for this book but I can't find it on the shelf.

lines.speaker: Görevli
lines.tr: Bakayım. Bu kitap şu anda başka bir öğrencide.
lines.en: Let me look. This book is with another student at the moment.

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: When will it come back?

lines.speaker: Görevli
lines.en: Next week. I can reserve it for you.

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.tr: Çok iyi olur. Sessiz bir çalışma odası da var mı?
lines.en: That would be great. Is there also a quiet study room?

lines.speaker: Görevli
lines.tr: Var, ikinci katta. Öğrenci kartınızla girebilirsiniz.
lines.en: Yes, on the second floor. You can get in with your student card.

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: What time does the library close?

lines.speaker: Görevli
lines.en: On weekdays it closes at midnight.

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: Thanks, take it easy!

phrases.en: I can't find it on the shelf.
I can reserve it for you.

writing.prompt: Describe a normal day of your PhD work in 3–5 sentences (present continuous).
writing.promptTr: Doktora çalışmalarında normal bir günü anlat.

title: What did you do yesterday?
setting: Your friend Can calls you; you spent the day in Gazimağusa.
settingTr: Arkadaşın Can arıyor; sen dün Gazimağusa'daydın.

lines.speaker: Can
lines.en: I called you yesterday but you didn't answer.

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: Sorry, my phone was left at home.

lines.speaker: Can
lines.en: Where did you go?

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: I went to Famagusta. I visited Salamis.

lines.speaker: Can
lines.en: How was it? Did you like it?

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: I loved it! I took lots of photos.

lines.speaker: Can
lines.en: Where did you have lunch?

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.tr: Eski şehirde küçük bir lokantada yedim. Molehiya denedim.
lines.en: I ate at a small restaurant in the old town. I tried molokhia.

lines.speaker: Can
lines.tr: Harika! Bir dahaki sefere beni de çağır.
lines.en: Great! Invite me too next time.

phrases.tr: Bir dahaki sefere beni de çağır.

writing.prompt: What did you do last weekend? Write 3–5 sentences in the past tense.
writing.promptTr: Geçen hafta sonu ne yaptın? Geçmiş zamanla 3–5 cümle yaz.

title: Weekend plans
setting: Making weekend plans with your colleague Elif.
settingTr: İş arkadaşın Elif'le hafta sonu planı yapıyorsunuz.

lines.speaker: Elif
lines.en: What will you do at the weekend?

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: On Saturday I'll go to Karpas. You?

lines.speaker: Elif
lines.en: I'll stay at home. I'll write my thesis.

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.tr: Pazar günü boş musun? Birlikte kahvaltı yapalım mı?
lines.en: Are you free on Sunday? Shall we have breakfast together?

lines.speaker: Elif
lines.en: Sure! Where shall we meet?

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.tr: Bellapais'te güzel bir kafe var. Saat onda orada olacağım.
lines.en: There's a nice café in Bellapais. I'll be there at ten.

lines.speaker: Elif
lines.tr: Tamam, ben de geleceğim. Arabayla mı gideceksin?
lines.en: Okay, I'll come too. Will you go by car?

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.en: No, I'll go by minibus.

lines.speaker: Elif
lines.en: Then see you on Sunday!

phrases.en: What will you do at the weekend?

writing.prompt: What will you do next weekend? Write 3–5 sentences in the future tense.
writing.promptTr: Gelecek hafta sonu ne yapacaksın? Gelecek zamanla yaz.

title: Recommending places
setting: A visiting friend from Istanbul asks you what to see in Northern Cyprus.
settingTr: İstanbul'dan gelen bir arkadaşın Kuzey Kıbrıs'ta ne görebileceğini soruyor.

lines.speaker: Deniz
lines.en: I have three days. What can I do?

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.tr: İlk gün Lefkoşa'yı gezebilirsin. Büyük Han çok güzel.
lines.en: On the first day you can explore Nicosia. The Great Inn is lovely.

lines.speaker: Deniz
lines.en: Can I swim in the sea?

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.tr: Tabii! Karpaz'da altın kumsallar var. Orada eşekleri de görebilirsin.
lines.en: Of course! There are golden beaches in Karpas. You can also see the donkeys there.

lines.speaker: Deniz
lines.en: Do I need to rent a car?

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.tr: Bence evet. Otobüsle Karpaz'a gitmek zor.
lines.en: I think so. Getting to Karpas by bus is hard.

lines.speaker: Deniz
lines.en: What should I eat?

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.tr: Şeftali kebabı ve hellimli tost mutlaka dene!
lines.en: Definitely try şeftali kebab and a halloumi toastie!

lines.speaker: Deniz
lines.en: Great, thanks a lot!

glossary.meaning: can enter (denize girmek = to swim in the sea)

phrases.en: Can I swim in the sea?
You can also see the donkeys there.

writing.prompt: A friend is visiting Northern Cyprus. Recommend 3 things they can do, using -(y)Abil.
writing.promptTr: Bir arkadaşın Kuzey Kıbrıs'a geliyor. Ne yapabileceğini yaz.
